title: 第十六章  围攻冰夷
content_zh:
“好强的恢复能力。”白衣人也是见多识广，但还是对墨非夜的恢复能力感到震撼。

    墨非夜空有强大的力量和恢复能力，但是杂乱无章的攻击，根本无法对白衣人形成有效攻击。白衣人周围元气涌动，水纹激荡，一支支水箭飞出。

    在水箭密集持续地攻击，墨非夜根本无法接近白衣人，转眼间就已经是遍体鳞伤。墨非夜身旁的血雾，不断地涌向各处伤口，在血雾的滋养下，就算在严重的伤口，都能马上恢复过来。

    “血灵”的表现，让白衣人的兴趣更加强烈。以自己的实力，要是能够化身为血灵，意味着自己在这片大陆，将难有对手。

    其实凭白衣人如今的实力，他的眼睛早就能恢复无碍，可是他没有。他就是要时时刻刻地提醒自己，记得这种屈辱，无论千年万年都不能忘记。

    墨非夜的状态，不光让白衣人感到吃惊，被囚禁在水泡中的雨归尘和芊芊，则更加意外。

    特别是雨归尘，她苦苦寻找不死草的原因之一，就是因为尘小楼受伤后恢复缓慢，如果尘小楼能和一样墨非夜，那真是不敢想象。

    白衣人原本想将墨非夜强行带走，经过各种尝试后，发现根本不可能。“血灵”根本不受元气的压制，原本足够压制天人境的元气，作用在血灵身上是一点作用都没有。

    一只只水泡出现在空中，将血灵团团框住。这种平常惯用的伎俩，也在血灵抓下纷纷破灭。

    凭现在释放出的力量，根本不可能控制住眼前这只血灵。

    可他如果释放出过多的力量，肯定会引来某些的关注。万一惹了某些人，有可能不是人带不走，自己都会有麻烦。

    可眼前的血灵，实在是太诱人。

    就算他再谨慎，也想要冒险一试。

    “快，一定要快。”

    磅礴的力量犹如巨浪，从白衣人体内迸发出来，汹涌澎湃，绵绵不绝。尽管力量在不断攀升，可白衣人的气质反而更加深邃，整个人犹如深潭，水面如镜波澜不兴。

    “嘭”的一声，白衣人未有任何动作，墨非夜被击出十多丈远，重重地摔在地上。紧接着一个水泡从天而下，重重地砸在墨非夜身上，将墨非夜包住。

    水泡中的墨非夜，这次却没有像前几次那样，马上就爬起来，而是在不停地挣扎，不停地试图站起，趴下，在站起，在趴下。

    “居然还能动弹。”白衣人的认知在不断被刷新。

    眼前抱住血灵的水泡，可不是普通的水泡，除了异常的坚固外，还有隔绝元气联系的作用。他刚才的一击，已将墨非夜全身的骨头打断，在水泡的包裹下，已与外部元气失去联系，就不可能像以前那般，快速地恢复。

    围绕在墨非夜身上的血雾，不仅没有随着元气的减少而散去，还相反变得更加浓郁，原本半透明的薄纱状，已变为黏稠的液体状，一缕缕围绕墨非夜周围。

    “这是怎么回事？他的能量从何而来？”在断绝元气的情况下，还能保持这种状态，白衣人是前所未闻。

    气是这个世界的本源，也是力量的来源，虽各自的叫法不同，但是其本质相同。从他目前的观察来看，血灵绝对不可能，有那么浓厚精纯的气来支持他的行动。

    如果真有这么浓厚精纯的气，血灵绝不会只是现在的水平。就现在单纯气的水平，可能不会比自己差。

    墨非夜持续旺盛的战斗力，让白衣人明白，如不下狠手，是无法将他带走。为今之计，只能赌上一把。

    水泡在墨非夜爪下，化为乌有。面对气势汹汹的墨非夜，白衣人这次没有做出其他多余的动作，而是直接迎了上去，更多的力量从他体内涌出，现场飞沙走石，日月无光，一把将墨非夜喉咙捏住，提了起来。
content_en:
"What a strong recovery ability." The man in white was also well-informed, but he was still shocked by Mo Feiye's recovery ability.

    Mo Feiyekong has strong strength and recovery ability, but his chaotic attacks cannot form an effective attack on the man in white. The energy around the man in white surged, the water ripples stirred, and water arrows flew out one after another.

    Under the intensive and continuous attack of water arrows, Mo Feiye was unable to get close to the man in white, and in the blink of an eye he was covered with cuts and bruises. The blood mist around Mo Feiye continued to flow into the wounds. With the nourishment of the blood mist, even serious wounds could be recovered immediately.

    The performance of the "blood spirit" made the man in white more interested. With his own strength, if he could transform into a blood spirit, it would mean that he would have no opponent in this continent.

    In fact, with the man in white's current strength, his eyes would have recovered long ago, but he didn't. He just wants to remind himself all the time that he can never forget this humiliation, no matter how long it takes.

    Mo Feiye's state not only surprised the man in white, but Yu Guichen and Qianqian who were imprisoned in the bubble were even more surprised.

    Especially for Yu Guichen, one of the reasons why she struggled to find the Immortal Grass was because Chen Xiaolou recovered slowly after being injured. It would be unimaginable if Chen Xiaolou could be like Mo Feiye.

    The man in white originally wanted to take Mo Feiye away by force, but after various attempts, he found that it was impossible. "Blood Spirit" is not suppressed by the vitality at all. The vitality that was originally enough to suppress the Heavenly Realm has no effect on the Blood Spirit.

    Bubbles appeared in the air one after another, surrounding the blood spirits. This usual trick has also been shattered by the blood spirit.

    With the power released now, it is impossible to control the blood spirit in front of him.

    But if he releases too much power, it will definitely attract some attention. If you offend someone, you may not be able to take them away, and you will be in trouble.

    But the blood spirit in front of him is really too tempting.

    No matter how cautious he is, he still wants to take a chance.

    "Quick, must be quick."

    The majestic power is like a huge wave, bursting out from the body of the man in white, surging and endless. Although his strength is constantly rising, the temperament of the man in white is getting deeper. His whole body is like a deep pool, and the water surface is as calm as a mirror.

    There was a "bang", but the man in white didn't make any move. Mo Feiye was hit more than ten feet away and fell heavily to the ground. Then a bubble of water fell from the sky and hit Mo Feiye hard, covering Mo Feiye.

    Mo Feiye, who was in the blisters, did not get up right away like he had done a few times before. Instead, he kept struggling, trying to stand up, lie down, stand up, and lie down.

    "I can still move." The man in white's knowledge was constantly being refreshed.

    The bubble hugging the blood spirit in front of him is no ordinary bubble. In addition to being unusually strong, it also has the effect of isolating the connection between vitality. The blow he just struck had broken all the bones in Mo Feiye's body. Wrapped in blisters, he had lost contact with the external energy, making it impossible to recover as quickly as before.

    The blood mist surrounding Mo Feiye not only did not dissipate with the decrease in vitality, but instead became more dense. The originally translucent gauze shape had turned into a viscous liquid shape, wisps surrounding Mo Feiye.

    "What's going on? Where does his energy come from?" It is unheard of for the man in white to be able to maintain this state despite being cut off from his vitality.

    Qi is the origin of this world and the source of power. Although they have different names, their essence is the same. Judging from his current observations, it is absolutely impossible for Blood Spirit to have such a thick and pure energy to support his actions.

    If there really was such a strong and pure Qi, Blood Spirit would never be at its current level. As for the current level of pure anger, it may not be worse than myself.

    Mo Feiye's continued strong fighting power made the man in white understand that he could not be taken away without ruthlessness. For the current plan, we can only take a gamble.

    The water soaked under Mo Feiye's claws and turned into nothing. Facing the menacing Mo Feiye, the man in white did not make any other unnecessary moves this time, but directly faced him. More power surged out of his body. The scene was filled with sand and rocks, and the sun and moon were dim. He pinched Mo Feiye's throat and lifted him up.
